# Street air quality: catalogue

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_catalogue.py from the code; do not edit by hand. -->

Street-canyon networks: canyon exchange, junction routing, above-roof plumes, chemistry and exposure (SIRANE and MUNICH physics, case readers and writers). How the pieces fit together: [Street air quality](../applications/street_aq.md).
Every application is set up the same way; see [Using noodl](../usage.md).

Import from `noodl.apps.street_aq`. The full reference, with every parameter, is in the [API reference](../api.md).

## Model options

Keyword arguments of `build_model` choosing the physics; a preset (`preset=`, one of `sirane`, `munich`) sets them all, and any given explicitly overrides it. A value marked with a preset's name is that preset's choice. Defined in `noodl.apps.street_aq.closures`.

| Option | Values | What it chooses |
|---|---|---|
| `canyon_wind` | `bessel_profile` (sirane)<br>`exponential_profile` (munich) | the along-canyon velocity. `bessel_profile` is the Soulhac, Perkins and Salizzoni (2008) closed form on the friction velocity; `exponential_profile` is the single-regime exponential profile on the roof-level wind (Kim et al. 2022, Eq. B14). |
| `roof_wind` | `bessel_canyon_mean` (sirane, munich)<br>`canopy_log_law` | the roof-level wind `u_H` the exponential profile needs. `bessel_canyon_mean` is the canyon mean of the Bessel profile (Kim et al. 2022, Eq. B12); `canopy_log_law` is a log law with Macdonald's (1998) displacement height and roughness. |
| `roof_exchange` | `turbulent_velocity` (sirane)<br>`aspect_ratio_scaled` (munich) | the roof exchange velocity. `turbulent_velocity` is `u_d = sigma_w / (sqrt(2) pi)`; `aspect_ratio_scaled` is Schulte's `u_d = beta sigma_w / (1 + H/W)`. |
| `junction_routing` | `non_crossing_streamlines` (sirane, munich)<br>`perfect_mixing` | how a junction's inflows are shared among its outflows. `non_crossing_streamlines` fills the outflows in angular order without crossing; `perfect_mixing` shares every inflow in proportion to the outflows. |
| `direction_averaging` | `none`<br>`exact_gaussian` (sirane)<br>`rectangle_rule` (munich)<br>`gauss_hermite` | the average of the junction routing over the wind-direction spread. `none` routes at the mean direction; `exact_gaussian` is the exact Gaussian average of the piecewise-constant routing; `rectangle_rule` is uniform sampling on `[-2 sigma, 2 sigma]` with unnormalised weights; `gauss_hermite` is an `n_theta`-point Gauss-Hermite quadrature. |
| `direction_spread` | `driver` (sirane)<br>`turbulence_intensity` (munich) | where the spread `sigma_theta` comes from. `driver` takes the `sigma_theta` driver, else the constructor value, else 0; `turbulence_intensity` is `sigma_theta = min(sigma_v / U_ref, 10 deg)`. |
| `stability` | `neutral`<br>`monin_obukhov` (sirane, munich) | the turbulence profiles. `neutral` is `sigma_w = 1.3 u* (1 - 0.8 z/h)`; `monin_obukhov` switches between unstable, neutral and stable branches on the Obukhov length, and is the neutral form wherever no `lmo` driver is given. |
| `sigma_w_height` | `canopy_height` (sirane)<br>`street_height` (munich) | the height at which the `sigma_w` of the roof exchange velocity is evaluated. `canopy_height` is one network-wide height above ground, `h_canopy` (SIRANE's `H_R`), the same for every street; `street_height` is each street's own height `H`. |
| `shape_constant` | `exact_root` (sirane)<br>`grid_search` (munich) | how the shape parameter `c` of the Bessel canyon profile is evaluated. `exact_root` solves the shape equation to machine precision; `grid_search` takes the point of the grid `c = 0.01, ..., 1.00` with the smallest residual, as MUNICH does (forward value quantised to 0.01, gradient of the exact root). |

Numeric settings each preset fixes (each also a `build_model` keyword):

| Setting | `sirane` | `munich` |
|---|---|---|
| `kappa` | `0.4` | `0.41` |
| `canyon_wind_min` | `0.0` | `0.1` |
| `u_d_min` | `0.0` | `0.001` |
| `sigma_w_min` | `0.3` | `0.0` |
| `sigma_v_min` | `0.5` | `0.0` |
| `h_canopy` | `20.0` | `20.0` |

## Set-up

Build the model and its starting state and inputs.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `build_model` | `(Model, initial state, driver template)` for one street network. | `build_model(net, *, preset='sirane', canyon_wind=None, roof_wind=None, roof_exchange=None, junction_routing=None, direction_averaging=None, direction_spread=None, stability=None, shape_constant=None, n_theta=None, sigma_theta=None, species=('nox',), chemistry=None, scheme='implicit', kappa=None, canyon_wind_min=None, u_d_min=None, sigma_w_min=None, sigma_v_min=None, sigma_w_height=None, h_canopy=None, z0_s=0.01, z_ref=30.0, pblh_floor=True, meteo='uniform', background='uniform', atmosphere='atmosphere', layer_name='street', **deprecated)` |
| `initial_drivers` | `build_model`'s driver template (copied), then `values` by name (see `noodl.refs.drivers_from`), e.g. by street and species name. | `initial_drivers(model, *, values=None)` |
| `initial_state` | Zero concentration everywhere, in each transport layer's own shape; then `values` by street and species name (see `noodl.refs.state_from`): `initial_state(model, values={"street": {"s1": {"nox": 1e-7}}})`. | `initial_state(model, *, values=None)` |

## Network components

Descriptions of the physical objects a network is built from.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `PlumeTable` | One plume trajectory per hour, resampled onto a distance grid (`plume_table`). | `PlumeTable(batch, sigma_y, p_z, u, step, x_max)` |
| `Street` | One street segment between junctions `u` and `v` (the azimuth points `u -> v`): its `length`, `width` and building `height` (m), the roughness length of its building walls `z0_b` (m, 0.15 by default) and `emission_scale`, a dimensionless factor applied to its emissions. | `Street(name, u, v, length, width, height, z0_b=0.15, emission_scale=1.0)` |
| `StreetCase` | One street-network case: the network plus every array a `Model` built on it needs to run, independent of which source model (`source`) it came from. | `StreetCase(source, network, times, street_ids, junction_ids, species, meteo, meteo_junction, emissions, background, native, start=None)` |
| `StreetResults` | One street model's own results, read format-neutral by `read_results` from a SIRANE result directory or a MUNICH `results/` directory. | `StreetResults(source, times, street_ids, species, c_in, c_above, u_canyon, sigma_w_roof, u_exchange, meteo)` |
| `StreetGeometry` | Everything `StreetFlows` needs about the streets, as plain tensors. | `StreetGeometry(names, u, v, length, width, height, z0_b, azimuth)` |
| `StreetNetwork` | Streets plus the x/y coordinates (metres) of every junction they name. | `StreetNetwork(streets, x, y, street_direction='planar', lon=None, lat=None, _azimuth=<factory>)` |

## Layers and model

The conservation layers and the model that steps them.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `BoundaryLayer` | Friction velocity and the turbulence it sets, batched over forcing instances. | `BoundaryLayer(u_star, h_abl, z_ref, d, z0, kappa=0.4)` |

## Closures

Functions of the state that compute drivers each step (densities, flows, levels).

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `StreetFlows` | The closure that turns the wind drivers into every prescribed edge flow. | `StreetFlows(net, layer, geometry, *, preset='sirane', canyon_wind=None, roof_wind=None, roof_exchange=None, junction_routing=None, direction_averaging=None, direction_spread=None, stability=None, shape_constant=None, n_theta=None, sigma_theta=None, kappa=None, canyon_wind_min=None, u_d_min=None, sigma_w_min=None, sigma_v_min=None, sigma_w_height=None, h_canopy=None, z0_s=0.01, z_ref=30.0, pblh_floor=True, meteo='uniform', layer_name='street', **deprecated)` |

## Files

Readers and writers of other tools' file formats.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `read_case` | `StreetCase` from `path`: a directory holding `munich.cfg` is read as a MUNICH case; a `.dat` file is read as a SIRANE master file (`Donnees_*.dat`) with the deck it names (see `_sirane_files.read_sirane_case` for what is read and what is refused). Anything else raises `ValueError` naming both expectations. | `read_case(path)` |
| `read_results` | `StreetResults` from `path`: a SIRANE result directory (holding `RUES_PAR_HEURE/` and `METEO/Resul_Meteo.dat`) or a MUNICH `results/` directory of `<species>.bin` files (see `_sirane_files.read_sirane_results`, `_munich_files.read_munich_results` for what each reads). | `read_results(path, *, case=None, hours='case')` |
| `write_case` | Writes `case` under `out_dir` in `format` (`"munich"` or `"sirane"`), and returns `out_dir`. `case.start` must be set: both formats date every input. | `write_case(out_dir, case, *, format='munich', options=None)` |
| `write_network_concentration` | Write a `network_concentration_<year>.nc` of per-street results, as classic CDF. | `write_network_concentration(path, *, time_hours, feature_index, osmid, background, canyon_velocity, concentration, year=None, solver_background=0.0)` |
| `write_sweep` | Writes a sweep of SIRANE decks under `out_dir` -- one per (direction, speed, source street, variant) -- plus `runs.csv`, a manifest of each deck's parameters; returns `out_dir`. | `write_sweep(out_dir, base_case, *, directions_deg, speeds, sources='unit_impulse', species='NO2', variants=None, chapman=0)` |

Supporting types.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |

## Functions

Calculations and helpers.

| Name | What it does | How to call it |
|---|---|---|
| `bessel_shape_parameter`<br><small>also `soulhac_shape`</small> | The shape parameter `c` of the Bessel canyon profile: the root of `bessel_shape_residual`, batched and differentiable in `ratio`. | `bessel_shape_parameter(ratio)` |
| `boundary_layer` | Friction velocity and the boundary-layer height from the network-mean geometry and reference wind, batched and differentiable. | `boundary_layer(h_mean, u_ref, h_abl, *, z_ref=30.0, kappa=0.4, pblh_floor=None)` |
| `canopy_displacement_roughness`<br><small>also `macdonald_profile`</small> | Macdonald (1998) displacement height and roughness length, `(d_c, z0c)`, in metres. | `canopy_displacement_roughness(h_mean, w_mean, *, lambda_p=0.4, big_delta=4.43, small_delta=1.0, c_db=1.2, kappa=0.41)` |
| `canyon_velocity` | The SIGNED along-canyon velocity, m/s. Positive means from `u` to `v`. | `canyon_velocity(W, H, phi, *, u_star=None, u_h=None, canyon_wind=None, z0_b=0.15, z0_s=0.01, kappa=0.4, canyon_wind_min=0.0, shape_constant='exact_root', form=None)` |
| `direction_offsets` | Wind-direction samples and their weights, `(offsets (..., m), weights (..., m))`. | `direction_offsets(direction_averaging=None, sigma_theta=None, *, n_theta=None, scheme=None)` |
| `downwind_cutoff` | SIRANE's downwind cut-off, m: `meteo_cell_dx / \|cos theta_w\|`, the x-size of the meteo-grid cell over the cosine of the wind's angle to the x axis (an empirical rule: 900 m cells give 910 m, 700 m cells 700 m whatever the cells' y-size, and a wind at 45 degrees to the axis ~1020 m; `\|cos\|` is floored at 1e-6). It holds for cells of about 700 m and larger: with smaller cells SIRANE stops the Gaussian plume much earlier (about 168 m for 350 m cells) and continues with a cell-based far field, which this kernel does not model. | `downwind_cutoff(theta_w, meteo_cell_dx)` |
| `drivers_at` | The driver mapping at time index `k` for `model`, built from `case`. | `drivers_at(case, model, k, *, species=None)` |
| `exact_gaussian_direction_samples`<br><small>also `sirane_direction_samples`</small> | The EXACT Gaussian direction average of the junction routing, as samples and weights `(offsets (..., n_j, m), weights (..., n_j, m))` -- SIRANE's `P^_ij(phi0) = int f(phi - phi0) P_ij(phi) dphi` (Soulhac et al. 2011, Atmos. Environ. 45:7379, Eq. 7) with `f` the normal density of standard deviation `sigma_theta`. | `exact_gaussian_direction_samples(theta, sigma_theta, slot_angle, slot_active)` |
| `exchange_velocity` | The roof exchange velocity `u_d`, m/s. | `exchange_velocity(sigma_w, H, W, *, roof_exchange=None, u_d_min=0.0, sigma_w_min=0.0, form=None)` |
| `grid_shape_parameter` | The shape parameter `c` the way MUNICH evaluates it: the point of the grid `c = 0.01, 0.02, ..., 1.00` that minimises `\|2/c exp((pi/2) Y1(c)/J1(c) - gamma_E) - z0/di\|` (ATM `ComputeSiraneC`, `MeteorologyStreet.cxx:114-152`; the first minimum wins on a tie, as MUNICH's strict `>` makes it). | `grid_shape_parameter(ratio)` |
| `exposure_reduction_adjoint` | Exposure reduction from cutting each listed street's emission by `delta_fraction` of their mean, to first order, from ONE steady solve and one backward pass (the adjoint); compare `exposure_reduction_forward`. | `exposure_reduction_adjoint(model, state, drivers, *, population, streets, delta_fraction=0.1)` |
| `exposure_reduction_forward` | The same exposure reductions as `exposure_reduction_adjoint`, by brute force: one steady solve per street with that street's emission cut (`len(streets) + 1` solves, no linearisation). | `exposure_reduction_forward(model, state, drivers, *, population, streets, delta_fraction=0.1)` |
| `from_test_network` | A fixed four-junction, three-street test geometry. | `from_test_network()` |
| `from_ug_m3` | ug/m3 -> kg/m3. | `from_ug_m3(x)` |
| `j_no2_elevation_cloud`<br><small>also `j_no2_sirane`</small> | SIRANE's NO2 photolysis rate `k1` (1/s) at solar elevation `elevation_deg` under `cloud_octas` of cloud (0 to 8). | `j_no2_elevation_cloud(elevation_deg, cloud_octas=0.0)` |
| `j_no2_zenith_table` | Clear-sky `J_NO2` [1/s] at `zenith_deg`, times `attenuation`. | `j_no2_zenith_table(zenith_deg, attenuation=1.0)` |
| `junction_kernel` | `batch + (n_streets, n_junctions)`: `C_ext` above street `i` (at its midpoint) per unit vertical-flux rate out of junction `j`, s/m3 -- SIRANE's intersection plume (Soulhac et al. 2011, Sect. 5.2: `C_ext` sums the contributions of upwind streets AND intersections), each junction one point source of `junction_sources`' width and clamp. `table`, `theta_w`, `cutoff_sigma` and `meteo_cell_dx` are `plume_kernel`'s. | `junction_kernel(net, table, *, theta_w, cutoff_sigma=4.0, meteo_cell_dx=None)` |
| `junction_sources` | `(xy (J, 2), width (J,), clamp (J,))`: every junction as one point source of width `W_j` and clamp `1/H_j`, with `W_j`, `H_j` the mean width and height of the streets that meet at the junction. The mean is a choice: on SIRANE's South Kensington fluxes, at the deck's downwind cut-off, it gives SIRANE's `C_ext` to a median 0.32 % and p90 1.38 %, against 0.35 % and 1.38 % with the largest width and height, and 0.53 % and 1.48 % with the smallest. | `junction_sources(net)` |
| `k_no_o3_jpl2003` | k(NO + O3) = 3.0e-12 exp(-1500/T) cm3 molecule^-1 s^-1, returned in m3 mol^-1 s^-1. | `k_no_o3_jpl2003(temperature)` |
| `k_no_o3_soulhac2011`<br><small>also `k_no_o3_sirane`</small> | k(NO + O3) = 1.325e6 exp(-1430/T) m3 mol^-1 s^-1 at `temperature` (K), SIRANE's rate (Soulhac et al. 2011, with the prefactor that reproduces SIRANE v2.1 output). | `k_no_o3_soulhac2011(temperature)` |
| `twelve_street_grid`<br><small>also `munich_idealised`</small> | The 12-street network of Kim et al. 2022 Fig. 1, p. 7374. | `twelve_street_grid(*, L=100.0, W=20.0, H=20.0)` |
| `n_theta_rectangle_rule`<br><small>also `n_theta_munich`</small> | The sample count of the `rectangle_rule` direction average: `ntheta = floor(sigma_theta in DEGREES)` (MUNICH, SRC `:3568`), as a long tensor, clamped to `[1, 10]`. MUNICH skips the averaging entirely at 1, i.e. below two degrees. | `n_theta_rectangle_rule(sigma_theta)` |
| `node_closure` | MUNICH's roof closure at an intersection, before any routing (SRC `:2980-3014`). | `node_closure(flux)` |
| `photostationary_for_streets` | The Leighton reaction wired to the `"no"`, `"no2"` and `"o3"` columns of `species`. | `photostationary_for_streets(species, *, preset=None, no_o3_rate=None, floor_ppb=None, j_key='J_NO2', temperature_key='temperature', molar_volume_key='molar_volume', closure=None)` |
| `plume_kernel` | Concentration at each receptor per unit rate at each source, s/m3: `batch + (R, P)`. | `plume_kernel(receptor_xy, source_xy, table, *, theta_w, width=0.0, clamp=inf, cutoff_sigma=4.0, meteo_cell_dx=None)` |
| `plume_table` | SIRANE's plume trajectory for each hour, resampled onto a 10 m grid (module docstring: the table). | `plume_table(*, u_star, h_abl, lmo, h_canopy, z0, d, sigma_theta, theta_star=None, temperature=288.15, sigma_v_min=0.5, sigma_w_min=0.3, tau_y=None, tau_z=None, centre_c=10.0, centre_k=0.675, x_max=700.0, kappa=0.4, neutral_abs_lmo=inf)` |
| `roof_wind` | Wind speed at roof level `u_H`, from the friction velocity. | `roof_wind(u_star, H, W, *, roof_wind=None, z0_s=0.01, kappa=0.41, h_mean=None, w_mean=None, n_levels=100, shape_constant='exact_root', form=None)` |
| `routing_matrix` | The street-to-street flux matrix `F[..., p, r]` from ORDERED, closed marginals. | `routing_matrix(flux_in, flux_out, *, junction_routing=None, model=None)` |
| `shape_parameter` | The Bessel shape parameter `c`, by the `shape_constant` closure option: `"exact_root"` is `bessel_shape_parameter` (the continuous root), `"grid_search"` is `grid_shape_parameter` (MUNICH's argmin on a 0.01 grid). | `shape_parameter(ratio, shape_constant='exact_root')` |
| `sigma_theta_turbulence_intensity`<br><small>also `sigma_theta_munich`</small> | `sigma_theta = min(sigma_v / U, 10 deg)` (SRC `:3567`; Blackadar 1997, Soulhac 2009), the `direction_spread="turbulence_intensity"` spread. | `sigma_theta_turbulence_intensity(sigma_v, u_ref)` |
| `solar_elevation` | The solar elevation (degrees) at `latitude_deg`, day `day_of_year` (1 January = 1) and clock time `hour` (fractional hours), in SIRANE's convention. | `solar_elevation(latitude_deg, day_of_year, hour)` |
| `source_points` | Each street's roof flux as SIRANE's sub-sources: a street `u -> v` of coordinate length `L` is cut into `n = floor(L / SUBSOURCE_LENGTH_M) + 1` equal segments with one sub-source at the centre of each, weight `1/n`, width `(L/n)\|sin phi\|` and clamp `min(CLAMP_LENGTH_M / W, 1/(H (1 - \|sin phi\|)))`, where `phi` is the angle between the street and the wind `theta_w` (radians counter-clockwise from east, the direction the wind blows TOWARD; any batch shape) and `W`, `H` the street's width and height. The coordinate length is used, not `Street.length`, because the points lie on the drawn segment. | `source_points(net, *, theta_w)` |
| `street_geometry` | The plain-tensor view of `net` that `StreetFlows` consumes. | `street_geometry(net)` |
| `street_index` | Street name -> its row of `"<layer>.x"`. | `street_index(model, *, layer_name='street')` |
| `street_kernel` | `batch + (n_streets, n_streets)`: `K[..., i, j]` is `C_ext` above street `i` (at its midpoint) per unit roof-flux rate of street `j`, s/m3. | `street_kernel(net, table, *, theta_w, self_contribution=False, cutoff_sigma=4.0, meteo_cell_dx=None)` |
| `street_population` | p_i = n_total * H_i L_i / sum_j H_j L_j (their eq. 6 with a common building depth and storey height, which cancel). | `street_population(net, *, n_total)` |
| `street_steady` | The steady state of transport AND chemistry, by an explicit fixed point. | `street_steady(model, state, drivers, *, reaction=None, tol=1e-14, max_iter=50, layer_name='street', **solve_kwargs)` |
| `street_steady_with_plume` | The steady state of the street network with `C_ext` from the above-roof plumes. | `street_steady_with_plume(model, state, drivers, *, kernel, junction_kernel, junction_source='upward', background=None, tol=1e-12, max_iter=100, relaxation=1.0, adjoint_rtol=1e-12, adjoint_restart=20, diagnostics=None, layer_name='street', **solve_kwargs)` |
| `to_ug_m3` | kg/m3 -> ug/m3. | `to_ug_m3(x)` |
| `total_exposure` | Population-weighted inhaled dose rate, `sum_i q p_i c_i`: breathing rate `q` times each street's population `p_i` times its concentration `c_i`. | `total_exposure(concentration, population, *, q=0.0001586111111111111)` |
